Resources
---------

* Volter (Goldfish) font is used for the pixel system font.
* The font used for Latin text is Terminus. East-Asian text is rendered with the WenQuanYi Micro Hei font. The Jenna Sue and RM Typerighter fonts are used for additional graphical text. See the \[licenses section\] for details.
* HigashiOme-Gothic is the font used for Japanese.
* Noto Sans and Noto Sans JP are used as backup fonts for special characters.
* FreeSound.org samples provided by the users...
